params.body: The test workflow runs on `ubuntu-latest`, which now resolves to Ubuntu 26.04. On gentells-dashboard that broke CI the same day: Playwright could not install Chromium on the new image, and the run stopped before the first test. This site runs the same `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` step (with Playwright 1.63), so it is pinned to `ubuntu-24.04` as well, where its runs have been green. A newer image becomes a deliberate change.
params.title: CI: run on ubuntu-24.04, where Playwright can install Chromium
